notes.title: The Final Update is out now!
notes.content:
Hey folks!

One year ago Exphelius: Arena arrived on Steam in Early Access, and throughout the year your feedback and ideas have been heard, with 3 major content updates bringing new features to the table. Today marks the end of Exphelius: Arena's development with one final big update, adding two new maps, a tutorial mode, partial controller support, QoL changes and many bug fixes.

The Tutorial

A basic tutorial level has been added to the game, and new players will have this mode selected. It's a small arena with several powerup pads and a 'dummy' Corvus ship that does no damage for you to try out the weapons on. There are also control schemes printed on the background of the map for your reference.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/a766ed6469bbcac7efd0ab2c5933ad8f6ec4ce1d.png

Controller Support

Controller support has been added during matches. No menu navigation is supported unfortunately, but now you can at least enjoy Exphelius: Arena in a twin-stick shooter fashion with PlayStation and Xbox gamepads.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/d35ad8bc129d0f8d7ddced46f0ce0a74f3af3c9b.png

Two New Maps

Named after its golden skies and cities of casinos and games, Gambler's Nebula stands as a dangerous but prosperous star system of opportunity. This arena is littered with high-security forces, so try avoiding the edges of the map...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/46e32117a9823b69e24e74cbc34f6f35907424ae.png

At the center of the galaxy lies a super-massive black hole. While regular black holes will devour everything in their wake, this one appears to also be emitting a strange energy that scientists can only insofar speculate about.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/f654c8c56b7a587ddd64b9f5114545398ed431ef.png

Other Changes

Many quality of life features and tweaks have been made in this update. The XP and Cash rewards have been redone to feel more rewarding and less grindy, and small changes have been made, such as rewards now 'stack' every time you retry or restart a match, so once you finally complete it and return to the menu, you'll be receiving rewards for all those matches you played.

Lots of rebalancing has happened in part spawn rates and AI difficulty, so hopefully now it's not too much of a breeze while still being friendly to new players.

And a couple of new music tracks have been added to the main menu, to get you ready for a match.


Changelog:
- Added a new Tutorial level and mode to help players learn how to play
- Also lets players practice and try out different powerups
- Added a 'dummy' ship with a unique Corvus skin to the Tutorial level
- This ship will try and attack you like regular opponents, but does no damage
- Added Partial Controller support. Only works during matches (PS4 and Xbox controllers only)
- Added control layout diagrams to the pause menu. They are also present in the background of the tutorial level
- New saves will default the selected arena and game mode to the Tutorial
- Added Display options 'Fullscreen Mode' and 'V-sync' to the options menu
- Fixed weird Options menu display scaling
- Fixed a bug where some options wouldn't save correctly
- Fixed a bug where the XP bar would be incorrectly filled upon starting the game
- Fixed a bug where the "Mechanic" achievement wouldn't be awarded when winning a new part
- Fixed AI pathfinding on The Outlander's Jewel
- Dramatically reduced cannon hazard damage
- Renamed some powerups to better reflect what they now do
	- "Health" powerup renamed to "Health Kit"
	- "Shield Recharged" powerup renamed to "Shield Battery"
- Disabled the scoreboard (not the top left one) until the match ends.
- Added more lore to many arena descriptions.
- Fixed the cursor lock state - cursor can now exit the window space
- New Map - "Gambler's Nebula" added
- New and final map - "World's End" added
- Fixed an issue with the options menu being too skinny during matches on certain resolutions
- Fixed broken logo splash transition
- Added two new music tracks to the main menu - 'The Underground' and 'Mayhem'
- Fixed some maps having escapable areas
- Improved AI powerup logic
- Increased XP gains per match by 300%
- Increased Cash gains per match by 25%
- Tweaked AI difficulty scaling for more balanced matches
- Reduced Missile powerup damage and ammunition
- Reduced Mines powerup damage and ammunition
- Reduced Super Shotgun powerup ammunition
- Reduced Seeker powerup ammunition
- Tweaked stars in the background of 'The Dead Zone' to reduce flickering
- Fixed an issue that caused laser turret damage to be different based on framerate
- Fixed a bug where recharge rates (such as boost, shield, etc.) could become negative on certain part and ship combinations
- Made the 'Go' button more visible on the Play screen
- Repositioned the 'Go' button on the Play screen so that Steam notifications no longer obscure it
- Retrying/Restarting a match now grants you the XP and Cash rewards you would have earned in that match
- Lowered ship prices by about 25%
- Endgame scoreboard now displays kills alongside contestant score
- Increased XP and Cash rewards in the Derby game mode to be more balanced against other game modes
- Increased Laser Beam powerup damage by 40%
- Fixed a bug where winning Team Deathmatches didn't contribute to the 'Pro' achievement 
- Opponent damage scales with level
- Added a 'Lock Cursor' option. Enabling this confines your cursor to the game window
- Fixed an issue where some options wouldn't save properly


I just want to give out a big thanks to everyone who playtested and offered suggestions throughout the year. You've been a big help and Exphelius: Arena wouldn't be this good without you. I'm happy with the way this game turned out, so this will be the last major content update. Once again, report any bugs to the Discord server (https://discord.gg/YzSbR6z) and enjoy Exphelius: Arena.

Big thanks,
- Khaeops

notes.title: Save the Date - Exphelius Full Release
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Exphelius: Arena has been on Steam for almost a year now, and in that time there has been lots of new content added to the game. In the beginning there were only 4 maps and that was basically it. No progression, and only a handful of powerups that didn't do much.

On the game's anniversary, November 18th, Exphelius: Arena will be officially leaving Early Access and having its final content update. Stay tuned for the update notes and details on the full release.

- Khaeops

notes.title: The Powered Update - Now Live!
notes.content:
The second major content update for Exphelius: Arena is now live! With this update comes an overhaul to both the in-game UI and combat system. New powerups and weapons have also been added, along with two new unique maps with deadly hazards.

The Combat

The UI for vitals (health, shields and boost) has been improved to look more modern and take up less of the screen. At the bottom of the screen is now a display for your currently equipped primary and secondary weapon - a new feature.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/8566f74be53ac797e8d800ba2833a55a00f87939.png

Certain powerups now occupy the new secondary weapon slot. Health and Shield powerups can now be carried and activated at will rather than being used up upon collection. New powerups have been added to take advantage of this feature, such as missiles, mines and the EMP, which can stun ships in its radius, giving you time to finish them off without being attacked.

All powerups now have a limited ammo capacity - no more infinite laser beams of death!

The Maps

A new arena has been created near the planet Helia, a wealthy home to hardworking businessmen and traders.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/070c4c781bd41e0024d1e6d1cb65392a576bb7d4.png

And you were complaining that the maps weren't hazardous enough - so feast your eyes on the beautiful Outlander's Jewel. This tourist destination is difficult to get to in Exphelius. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/d8c3bdf732d666710f1ff164e626287da661db27.png

It's also difficult to survive, with 5 alternating laser cannons and several floating plasma cannons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/880df5971da627721ba6464546cac58c87b35bd4.png

Extras

Achievements have finally been added to the game, starting with 7 for you to collect. They will involve you in tasks such as pimping out your ships with Legendary parts, or owning all 12 ships.

And here's the changelog:
- Added 5 new powerups - Ricochet, EMP, Missile, Mines, Seeker
- Powerups now have an ammo capacity and can run out
- Added a secondary fire mode (RMB). EMP, Missile, Mines, Seeker, Shield Regen and Health Regen powerups are now activated using the secondary fire.
- Added new unique sound effects to most weapons
- Changed the Health, Shield and Boost UI
- Added a targeting feature - Arrows will appear around targets you look at, indicating you are targeting them. These arrows change colour based on what team the opponent is on
- Improved ship rotation behaviour - now no longer 'eases in/out' of turns
- Minor improvements to AI targeting decisions
- Minor improvements to AI pathfinding performance
- Added 2 new maps - Helia and The Outlander's Jewel
- Changed 'Quickplay' to 'Play'
- Opponents can now be a higher level than the player
- Improved particle performance
- Added Steam Achievements.
- Added sound effects for collecting XP, cash and parts at the end of a match
- Added sound effects for purchasing parts
- Dropped support for x86 architectures

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/edba963b481610307865abe802007dc3ec0f62fd.png

Please report any bugs, feedback or ideas over on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/YzSbR6z

Enjoy the update!

- Khaeops

notes.title: Quickplay Parts Update - Now Live!
notes.content:
The wait is over as the first content update arrives for Exphelius: Arena! With this update comes many new features, overhauls, fixes and improvements. Several changes and fixes have also been made thanks to your feedback.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QMRb9KbnW8Y&feature=youtu.be


The Parts

At the end of each match, you will receive XP and Cash, and if you were victorious, a new part will be offered to you. You will have the option to equip the new part, or keep your old part.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/46b31867c4417c723098ed4848d06fc0b233f3bd.png

Using your cash, you can purchase new parts from the part shop. These parts come in 4 types - Thrusters, Hull, Shield and Weapons, and installing them offer randomised stat bonuses to your ship depending on their rarity. There are a total of 10 rarities, with the higher ones being more common the higher your player level is, up to level 80.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/a3d2b0f7d8d6a9baa94e8a3f885315d49c149cbf.png

Speaking of levels, opponents will have similar levels to you and thus have random parts equipped during matches, to keep the game interesting and each contestant unique.

Ships now cost money to unlock, with the Corvus being the free starter ship. Skins do not cost to unlock - they come with the ship. When switching ships, parts that you have installed are carried over.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/e62414a24e42d718ce39d2255406a1c72206f815.png


The UI Overhaul

The Quickplay menu has been changed to make it easier to access all these new features. Rather than going through several steps before entering a match, you are now presented with buttons to each section, meaning you can skip steps that you don't want to change. They also now save their previous setting so that you can easily repeat matches without having to set them over and over.

Stat bars have also been replaced by radial bars for more intuitive viewing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/4f3d38a17e7681a874088becc21a94af7df2bd04.png

A result of this however has been the removal of the control scheme selection. This will be returning to the game at a later update, in the options menus.


The Arenas

This update introduces two new arenas: The Rink and Mining Sector 38-B3.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/57a6d92faa5c1d29404fa72ba00ce3df8d53110c.png

The Rink is a highly visited tourism and mining destination, valued for its icy composition. Enjoy the chilling vistas of orange explosions contrasted against the cold blue ice field.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/dc4e2c6c9ee75aec0f1b025fc1279e1ca339d9eb.png

The mining sector located in galactic sector 38-B3 serves as a staging area for some of the Viytrunian Empire's manufacturing plants. In the distance are several capital-class transport vessels, and the mining facility itself is guarded with large turrets that will shoot on sight. During your battles here, be wary of these turrets as they can swiftly down a ship.


Other changes:


 There are a total of 10 stats that parts can modify: movement speed, turn rate, boost strength, capacity and recharge rate, total health, shield capacity and recharge rate, damage and mass.
 Integrated Steam features such as username and avatar.
 Slightly improved AI behaviour by introducing basic flanking
 Made police AI less willing to ram you
 Renamed 'Outrun' to 'Pursuit'
 Removed 'Marathon' mode
 Removed 'The Dust Run' arena
 Introduced new shaders for backgrounds that are more performant and detailed
 Several performance improvements
 Progress is saved, as well as a few hidden stats
 Gamemode selection now shows showcase images in the background
 Upgraded post processing shaders
 Many bug fixes


Please report any bugs, feedback or ideas over on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/YzSbR6z

What's Next?

A new suite of powerups is in development, plus some new arenas with proper hazards, and the first set of Steam achievements. Again, if you have any ideas you'd like to see in the game, please voice them on our Discord server, linked above.

That's going to be it from me for now folks, enjoy the update!

- Khaeops

notes.title: Upcoming Quickplay Updates
notes.content:
Hey folks, hope you all had a good holiday!

A lot has been happening in the development of the next set of updates for Exphelius: Arena. More specifically, preparation for the first rollout of Campaign mode, but more so the overhaul of Quickplay. Lots of changes to the code base and optimisation as well as some AI tweaks means a more performance-friendly experience. On top of that, lots of new features and content to keep you playing. This post serves to inform you of how these are going to be delivered, and what to expect in them.

Part 1: Quickplay Parts

The Quickplay Update will actually be split into several smaller updates so that their features can be delivered earlier - there's a lot in development and I didn't want to keep everyone waiting for too long.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/6c127a4344f7904642e6e0aa87ab86caf9084b05.png

The first update will feature an in-game currency, an XP system and a performance part system, allowing you to earn parts from matches or purchase them from an in-game store using money you earn from matches. These parts have randomised stats and rarities similar to what you might find in an ARPG. You can equip parts into an 'equipment slot' that persists regardless of the ship you are using, since Quickplay features stock regulated ships that are designed to interface alike.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36110658/97a2ca8ca19b94cd36c37f5f49f64b45aff3892f.png

You can only own one item of each category at any one time, but you can easily compare your stats before and after before confirming which part you wish to keep. The part you don't keep is turned into currency which can be used to purchase other parts, new ships or later, ship skins.


Part 2: Quickplay Overhaul

This one focuses more on the actual gameplay featured in Quickplay. At the moment Exphelius features only a few gamemodes, one of which does not entirely work all too well (Marathon). In this update, Marathon will be removed, and other gamemodes are intended to be added in its place.

More powerups and a powerup limit are planned, meaning more variety but you also have a limit to how much you can use the powerup. As it currently stands, you can fire off a Laser Beam or Minigun powerup for as long as you like as long as you aren't killed or don't pick up another powerup. This tends to get a little overpowered. The solution will be to add an ammunition count for each weapon. When you run out of ammo, your ship returns to its regular fire mode.

That's all for now. I'm almost done with the parts system and will be pushing that into beta for insiders to test before making it an official public release. If you're interested in becoming an insider, consider dropping by our Discord server (https://discord.gg/YzSbR6z) and sending me a message. I'm also preparing myself a setup to start doing development livestreams on our YouTube channel within the next month, so be sure to keep an eye out for that.

- Khaeops

notes.title: Welcome to Exphelius: Arena
notes.content:
Hey folks, Khaeops here from Pharazen Studios!

Only a week remains until the initial launch of Exphelius: Arena! With that in mind I thought I'd let you all know a bit more about this game, what it means to us and our plans for the future.

Exphelius: Arena is currently a solo project. I (Khaeops) am the sole creator of the story and the assets, such as the code, music, artwork and design. The only exception at the moment is some sound effects, which come from purchased asset packs.

This game is an Early Access title, which means it is in development whilst also being available to the public to purchase, play and review as they please. I cannot promise you that this game becomes what you wish it to be, but I can promise you that this game will be finished in the near future. I am committed and motivated to bringing it to a high standard. In saying that, your (the community's) feedback is highly important to me.

I am also keen on the idea of being as open as possible about this game's development, and as such, I will be posting content on these forums, the Pharazen Discord server, and the Pharazen YouTube channel showcasing some development of the game. I like the idea of an open community where ideas can be shared, and I hope you all do too.

I hope this information gives you an idea of what's in store for Exphelius: Arena. If what you read above interests you, I invite you to join me and our friendly community on the Pharazen Studios Discord server (https://discord.gg/YzSbR6z), and stay tuned to our YouTube Channel (https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEHoRXkrV0ON8Xxy_BYUgUQ).

See you all soon,

- Khaeops
